Breakfast with Santa

05 Dec 2026 You and your family are invited to a festive breakfast celebration with Santa! Enjoy delicious North Pole pancakes prepared by Santa’s elves, take photos with Santa, and explore a holiday workshop filled with crafts and activities for children.

Quinlan Community Center, 10185 North Stelling Road,  95014

Tagged as: , Community events & fundraisers, Kids & family, Major events, City Wide Events

Signing Santa

12 Dec 2026 Deaf and hard of hearing children, along with their families, are invited to spend time with a Santa who understands sign language! Santa only communicates using sign language but an interpreter will be on-site to help translate for friends and family.

Quinlan Community Center, 10185 North Stelling Road,  95014

Tagged as: , Kids & family, City Wide Events
